# What this notebook does

Kate, 2026-10-12 (parameterized 2026-10-20): the simplest readable model of `r params$effect`,
`r params$label`:

`te_lfc ~ cds_gc + log2_cds_length`

CDS GC and log2 CDS length were chosen because they are the two features the hypoxia 1hr
random-forest regression leans on most once near-duplicates are set aside (`gc3_internal` is
~0.93-correlated with `cds_gc` and would only split its credit). Section 1b prints, for *this*
contrast, the forest's SHAP ranking, the predictor correlations and the non-linearity checks, so
the choice can be re-judged per contrast. The regression itself uses no forest output.

- **Outcome:** `te_lfc` from DESeq2, `r params$outcome_label`. Positive = `r params$positive_means`.
  The direction is checked against the data in section 1.
- **Genes:** every gene in the feature matrix with a TE LFC and both predictors.
- **Linear only.** Section 1b reports how much curved fits (splines) would add and where the
  slopes bend. Deliberately left out of the model for now.
- **No held-out set.** Three fitted numbers on ~10,000 genes cannot overfit; a 10-fold
  cross-validated R² is printed alongside the in-sample one to show it.
- **Run all contrasts** with `13c_render_contrasts.R`, which knits this notebook once per contrast.

```{r libraries}
suppressPackageStartupMessages({ library(tidyverse); library(here); library(patchwork) })
O <- here("output", "translational_control_overview")
# Orange is reserved for eIF3d (CLAUDE.md); a contrast with no knockdown gets black lines.
line_col <- if (params$contrast_kind == "knockdown") "#E69F00" else "black"
```

# 1. Data, and checks that it is the right data

Every check here stops the knit on failure. The aim is that a wrong file, a wrong contrast, a
flipped direction or a broken join cannot produce a figure.

```{r data}
# 1a. The params must be one of the registered contrasts, so a mistyped file cannot slip through
contrasts <- tribble(
  ~tag,                  ~de_file,                                                       ~contrast_kind, ~aliases,                         ~rf_suffix,
  "hypoxia_1hr",         "translation_categories_si3d_vs_sictrl_hypoxia_1hr.csv",        "knockdown",    "",                               "eif33d_promotes_hypoxia_1hr_lfc0.5_tcoreg_intrinsic_corrected_both_clipaggregate_yraw",
  "normoxia_1and4hr",    "translation_categories_si3d_vs_sictrl_normoxia_1and4hr.csv",   "knockdown",    "",                               "eif33d_promotes_normoxia_1and4hr_lfc0.5_tcoreg_intrinsic_corrected_both_clipaggregate_yraw",
  "sictrl_hypvsnor_1hr", "sictrl_hypoxia_vs_normoxia_te_1hr.csv",                         "condition",    "translation_categories_1hr.csv", "eif3ctrl_promotes_hypvsnor_1hr_lfc0.5_tcoreg_intrinsic_corrected_both_clipaggregate_yraw")
reg <- contrasts %>% filter(tag == params$tag)
stopifnot("tag is not a registered contrast" = nrow(reg) == 1,
          "de_file does not belong to this tag" = reg$de_file == params$de_file,
          "contrast_kind does not belong to this tag" = reg$contrast_kind == params$contrast_kind,
          "rf_suffix does not belong to this tag" = params$rf_suffix %in% c("", reg$rf_suffix),
          "outcome file missing" = file.exists(here("output", params$de_file)))

de <- read_csv(here("output", params$de_file), show_col_types = FALSE) %>%
  mutate(gene_id_clean = sub("[.].*", "", gene_id))
stopifnot("duplicate genes in the outcome file" = !anyDuplicated(de$gene_id_clean),
          "outcome file has no te_lfc / te_padj" = all(c("te_lfc", "te_padj", "symbol") %in% names(de)),
          "te_lfc not finite" = all(is.finite(de$te_lfc[!is.na(de$te_lfc)])),
          "te_padj outside [0, 1]" = all(de$te_padj >= 0 & de$te_padj <= 1, na.rm = TRUE))

# 1b. Direction and identity of the contrast
if (params$contrast_kind == "knockdown") {
  # The siRNA depletes its own target, so EIF3D mRNA must be strongly positive under
  # log2(sictrl / si3d) (~+2.9 hypoxia 1hr, ~+3.1 normoxia 1+4hr). EIF3E must NOT be: a strongly
  # positive EIF3E would mean an si3e table was loaded.
  kd <- de %>% filter(symbol %in% c("EIF3D", "EIF3E")) %>% dplyr::select(symbol, rna_lfc)
  stopifnot("knockdown file lacks rna_lfc" = "rna_lfc" %in% names(de),
            "EIF3D / EIF3E not each present once" = setequal(kd$symbol, c("EIF3D", "EIF3E")) && nrow(kd) == 2,
            "EIF3D rna_lfc not strongly positive: direction flipped or wrong knockdown" = kd$rna_lfc[kd$symbol == "EIF3D"] > 1,
            "EIF3E rna_lfc strongly positive: this looks like an si3e table" = kd$rna_lfc[kd$symbol == "EIF3E"] < 1)
  cat(sprintf("EIF3D rna_lfc %+.2f, EIF3E rna_lfc %+.2f -> si3d, log2(sictrl / si3d) confirmed\n",
              kd$rna_lfc[kd$symbol == "EIF3D"], kd$rna_lfc[kd$symbol == "EIF3E"]))
} else {
  # No knockdown: siCTRL hypoxia vs normoxia, log2(hypoxia / normoxia), written by
  # 10y_sictrl_hypoxia_outcome_prep.R from translation_categories_1hr.csv. HIF targets' RNA barely
  # moves at 1hr, so the direction ruler is the same series at 24hr (as asserted in 10y_).
  stopifnot("condition file should carry no rna_lfc (10y_ drops it)" = !"rna_lfc" %in% names(de))
  ann <- read_tsv(here("accessories", "human", "gene_anno_hs_dm_v49_r111.tsv"), col_names = FALSE, show_col_types = FALSE) %>%
    transmute(gene_id_clean = sub("[.].*", "", X1), symbol = X2) %>% distinct(gene_id_clean, .keep_all = TRUE)
  h24 <- read_csv(here("output", "translation_categories_24hr.csv"), show_col_types = FALSE) %>%
    mutate(gene_id_clean = sub("[.].*", "", gene_id)) %>% dplyr::select(-any_of("symbol")) %>%
    left_join(ann, by = "gene_id_clean") %>% filter(symbol %in% c("CA9", "VEGFA", "EGLN3"))
  stopifnot("HIF targets not found at 24hr" = nrow(h24) == 3,
            "HIF targets' RNA not up at 24hr: hypoxia/normoxia direction flipped" = all(h24$rna_lfc > 0.5))
  cat(sprintf("HIF targets' rna_lfc at 24hr (same series): %s -> log2(hypoxia / normoxia) confirmed\n",
              paste(sprintf("%s %+.2f", h24$symbol, h24$rna_lfc), collapse = ", ")))
}

# 1c. Fingerprint: the outcome must match exactly the file(s) it should, and no other contrast
fm <- readRDS(file.path(O, "feature_matrix_tco.rds"))
stopifnot("feature matrix has duplicate genes" = !anyDuplicated(fm$gene_id_clean))
cand <- c(list.files(here("output"), pattern = "^translation_categories_.*[.]csv$"),
          list.files(here("output"), pattern = "^sictrl_hypoxia_vs_normoxia_te_.*[.]csv$"))
y_ref <- de$te_lfc[match(fm$gene_id_clean, de$gene_id_clean)]
fp <- map_dfr(cand, function(f) {
  x <- read_csv(here("output", f), show_col_types = FALSE, col_select = any_of(c("gene_id", "te_lfc")))
  if (!all(c("gene_id", "te_lfc") %in% names(x))) return(NULL)
  v <- x$te_lfc[match(fm$gene_id_clean, sub("[.].*", "", x$gene_id))]
  ok <- !is.na(v) & !is.na(y_ref)
  tibble(file = f, n_shared = sum(ok), max_dev = max(abs(v[ok] - y_ref[ok])),
         spearman = cor(v[ok], y_ref[ok], method = "spearman"))
})
# 1e-12, not 0: a CSV round trip moves values by ~1e-17; any other contrast differs by > 0.1
identical_files <- fp$file[fp$max_dev < 1e-12 & fp$n_shared > 0.9 * nrow(fm)]
expected <- setdiff(c(params$de_file, strsplit(reg$aliases, ",")[[1]]), "")
cat("Outcome files identical to this one on the matrix genes:", paste(identical_files, collapse = ", "), "\n")
stopifnot("outcome matches an unexpected file, or misses an expected alias" = setequal(identical_files, expected))
stopifnot("another contrast is suspiciously close to this outcome" = all(fp$max_dev[!fp$file %in% identical_files] > 0.01))
fp %>% filter(!file %in% identical_files) %>% slice_max(spearman, n = 3) %>%
  knitr::kable(digits = 3, caption = "Closest OTHER contrasts (must not be identical)")
if (params$contrast_kind == "condition") {
  # CLAUDE.md audit F7: the matrix's te_lfc label column IS this 1hr contrast
  stopifnot("condition outcome does not reproduce the matrix's te_lfc label (F7)" =
              max(abs(fm$te_lfc - y_ref), na.rm = TRUE) < 1e-12)
}

# 1d. Genes and predictors, straight from the matrix (no forest output)
d <- fm %>% transmute(gene_id_clean, symbol,
                      cds_gc = as.numeric(unlist(cds_gc)),
                      log2_cds_length = as.numeric(unlist(log2_cds_length)),
                      cds_nt = as.numeric(unlist(cds_length))) %>%
  inner_join(de %>% filter(!is.na(te_lfc)) %>% dplyr::select(gene_id_clean, te_lfc, te_padj), by = "gene_id_clean") %>%
  filter(!is.na(cds_gc), !is.na(log2_cds_length)) %>%
  arrange(gene_id_clean)   # fixed order, so the cross-validation folds do not depend on file order
stopifnot("log2_cds_length is not log2(cds_length + 1)" = max(abs(d$log2_cds_length - log2(d$cds_nt + 1))) < 1e-9,
          "CDS GC outside [0, 100]" = all(d$cds_gc >= 0 & d$cds_gc <= 100),
          "ACTB CDS GC outside 50-70%" = between(d$cds_gc[d$symbol == "ACTB"], 50, 70),
          "ACTB CDS is not 1,128 nt (375 aa + stop)" = d$cds_nt[d$symbol == "ACTB"] == 1128,
          "GC3 median outside 40-65%" = between(median(as.numeric(unlist(fm$gc3_internal)), na.rm = TRUE), 40, 65),
          "fewer than 9,000 genes - a join has dropped most of the data" = nrow(d) > 9000)
cat(sprintf("genes modelled: %s of %s in the matrix | median CDS GC %.1f%% | median CDS %s nt | TE LFC median %.3f, SD %.3f\n",
            scales::comma(nrow(d)), scales::comma(nrow(fm)), median(d$cds_gc),
            scales::comma(median(d$cds_nt)), median(d$te_lfc), sd(d$te_lfc)))
cat(sprintf("genes with TE LFC > 0.5 and padj < 0.05: %s\n", scales::comma(sum(d$te_lfc > 0.5 & d$te_padj < 0.05, na.rm = TRUE))))

# 1e. Optional cross-check against the forest run for this contrast (not used by the regression)
md_f <- file.path(O, paste0("rfreg_model_data_", params$rf_suffix, ".rds"))
if (nzchar(params$rf_suffix) && file.exists(md_f)) {
  md <- readRDS(md_f); mg <- bind_rows(md$train, md$test)
  stopifnot("forest outcome transformed" = md$target_transform == "raw",
            "forest genes differ from this notebook's genes" = setequal(mg$gene_id_clean, d$gene_id_clean),
            "forest outcome differs from this outcome file" = max(abs(mg$y - d$te_lfc[match(mg$gene_id_clean, d$gene_id_clean)])) < 1e-12,
            "forest's CDS GC differs from the matrix value used here" =
              max(abs(mg$cds_gc - d$cds_gc[match(mg$gene_id_clean, d$gene_id_clean)])) < 1e-9,
            "forest's log2 CDS length differs from the matrix value used here" =
              max(abs(mg$log2_cds_length - d$log2_cds_length[match(mg$gene_id_clean, d$gene_id_clean)])) < 1e-9)
  cat("forest cross-check passed: same genes, identical outcome, identical predictor values\n")
} else cat("no forest run for this contrast; cross-check skipped\n")
```

# 1b. Context: SHAP ranking, predictor correlations and non-linearity, for this contrast

```{r intro_numbers}
# SHAP shares: the forest's out-of-fold SHAP for this contrast (23_shap_gene_clustering.Rmd), if it exists.
# Context for the choice of predictors only; nothing below depends on it.
f_oof <- file.path(O, paste0("shap_oof_", params$rf_suffix, ".rds"))
if (nzchar(params$rf_suffix) && file.exists(f_oof)) {
  oof <- readRDS(f_oof)
  stopifnot("SHAP genes are not this notebook's genes" = setequal(oof$genes$gene_id_clean, d$gene_id_clean),
            "SHAP file's outcome is not this outcome" =
              max(abs(oof$genes$y - d$te_lfc[match(oof$genes$gene_id_clean, d$gene_id_clean)])) < 1e-12)
  shap_share <- sort(100 * colMeans(abs(oof$S)) / sum(colMeans(abs(oof$S))), decreasing = TRUE)
  print(tibble(rank = 1:5, feature = names(shap_share)[1:5], pct_of_mean_abs_shap = shap_share[1:5]) %>% knitr::kable(digits = 1))
  cat(sprintf("rank of cds_gc %d, log2_cds_length %d (of %d features)\n", match("cds_gc", names(shap_share)),
              match("log2_cds_length", names(shap_share)), length(shap_share)))
} else cat("no SHAP file for this contrast\n")
# gc3 vs cds_gc: why gc3 is left out
gc3 <- as.numeric(unlist(fm$gc3_internal[match(d$gene_id_clean, fm$gene_id_clean)]))
cat(sprintf("Spearman rho(gc3_internal, cds_gc) = %.3f | rho(cds_gc, log2 CDS length) = %.3f\n",
            cor(gc3, d$cds_gc, method = "spearman", use = "complete.obs"),
            cor(d$cds_gc, d$log2_cds_length, method = "spearman")))
# Non-linearity: natural splines (4 df each) vs the linear model
fit_lin <- lm(te_lfc ~ cds_gc + log2_cds_length, data = d)
fit_spl <- lm(te_lfc ~ splines::ns(cds_gc, 4) + splines::ns(log2_cds_length, 4), data = d)
cat(sprintf("adjusted R2: linear %.4f | splines %.4f | gain %.4f\n", summary(fit_lin)$adj.r.squared,
            summary(fit_spl)$adj.r.squared, summary(fit_spl)$adj.r.squared - summary(fit_lin)$adj.r.squared))
# Where the bends are: the additive model refit on each side of a cut
side_slopes <- function(lo, hi, term, scale) c(scale * coef(lm(te_lfc ~ cds_gc + log2_cds_length, data = lo))[[term]],
                                               scale * coef(lm(te_lfc ~ cds_gc + log2_cds_length, data = hi))[[term]])
gc_s <- side_slopes(filter(d, cds_gc < 55), filter(d, cds_gc >= 55), "cds_gc", 10)
len_s <- side_slopes(filter(d, cds_nt < 1700), filter(d, cds_nt >= 1700), "log2_cds_length", 1)
cat(sprintf("GC slope per +10 points: below 55%% %.3f | 55%% and above %.3f\n", gc_s[1], gc_s[2]))
cat(sprintf("length slope per doubling: below 1,700 nt %.3f | 1,700 nt and above %.3f\n", len_s[1], len_s[2]))
```

# 2. The model

```{r fit}
fit <- lm(te_lfc ~ cds_gc + log2_cds_length, data = d)
summary(fit)

# Per-SD slopes: refit on z-scored PREDICTORS only, so each slope is TE LFC per SD of the predictor.
# Not the standardized beta of section 5, which also z-scores the outcome (SD per SD).
fit_z <- lm(te_lfc ~ scale(cds_gc) + scale(log2_cds_length), data = d)
ci <- confint(fit)
coefs <- tibble(term = c("CDS GC", "CDS length"),
                per_unit = coef(fit)[-1],
                natural = c(10 * coef(fit)[["cds_gc"]], coef(fit)[["log2_cds_length"]]),
                natural_lo = c(10 * ci["cds_gc", 1], ci["log2_cds_length", 1]),
                natural_hi = c(10 * ci["cds_gc", 2], ci["log2_cds_length", 2]),
                natural_unit = c("per +10 percentage points GC", "per doubling of CDS length"),
                lfc_per_sd = coef(fit_z)[-1],
                p = summary(fit)$coefficients[-1, 4])
knitr::kable(coefs, digits = c(0, 4, 3, 3, 3, 0, 3, 300))

# 10-fold cross-validated R2, to show in-sample R2 is not inflated.
set.seed(9); fold <- sample(rep(1:10, length.out = nrow(d)))
pred_cv <- numeric(nrow(d))
for (k in 1:10) pred_cv[fold == k] <- predict(lm(te_lfc ~ cds_gc + log2_cds_length, data = d[fold != k, ]), d[fold == k, ])
r2_cv <- 1 - sum((d$te_lfc - pred_cv)^2) / sum((d$te_lfc - mean(d$te_lfc))^2)
# Adjusted R2 is reported wherever models with different numbers of terms are compared or a
# model's fit is quoted; the cross-validated R2 is already out-of-sample and is not adjusted.
r2 <- summary(fit)$r.squared; r2_adj <- summary(fit)$adj.r.squared
cat(sprintf("R2 %.4f | adjusted R2 %.4f | 10-fold cross-validated R2 %.4f | n = %d\n", r2, r2_adj, r2_cv, nrow(d)))

# Each term alone, for how much the other adds.
alone <- tibble(model = c("CDS GC only", "CDS length only", "CDS GC + CDS length"),
                r2 = c(summary(lm(te_lfc ~ cds_gc, d))$r.squared,
                       summary(lm(te_lfc ~ log2_cds_length, d))$r.squared, r2),
                adj_r2 = c(summary(lm(te_lfc ~ cds_gc, d))$adj.r.squared,
                           summary(lm(te_lfc ~ log2_cds_length, d))$adj.r.squared, r2_adj))
knitr::kable(alone, digits = 4)
cat(sprintf("Predictor correlation: Spearman rho(CDS GC, log2 CDS length) = %.3f\n",
            cor(d$cds_gc, d$log2_cds_length, method = "spearman")))
```

# 3. Figure

Each panel shows every gene (grey) and the model's line for that term with the other held at its
median (orange for an eIF3d knockdown, black for a contrast without one). The model is additive, so each line is the same whatever value the other
term is held at; only its height changes.

```{r figure, fig.width = 6, fig.height = 5}
gc_med <- median(d$cds_gc); len_med <- median(d$log2_cds_length)
line_gc <- tibble(cds_gc = seq(min(d$cds_gc), max(d$cds_gc), length.out = 100), log2_cds_length = len_med) %>%
  mutate(pred = predict(fit, newdata = .))
line_len <- tibble(log2_cds_length = seq(min(d$log2_cds_length), max(d$log2_cds_length), length.out = 100), cds_gc = gc_med) %>%
  mutate(pred = predict(fit, newdata = .))
ylim <- quantile(d$te_lfc, c(0.01, 0.99))
# Two separate figures, each carrying the model, its fit and n, since it may be shown alone.
fit_lab <- annotate("text", x = Inf, y = Inf, hjust = 1.1, vjust = 1.4, size = 3.8,
                   label = sprintf("adjusted R² = %.3f\nn = %s genes", r2_adj, scales::comma(nrow(d))))
p_gc <- ggplot(d, aes(cds_gc, te_lfc)) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, colour = "grey50", linewidth = 0.3) +
  geom_point(colour = "grey70", size = 0.3, alpha = 0.4) +
  geom_line(data = line_gc, aes(y = pred), colour = line_col, linewidth = 1) + fit_lab +
  coord_cartesian(ylim = ylim) +
  labs(x = "CDS GC (%)", y = params$outcome_label,
       title = sprintf("%s vs CDS GC\n%s", params$effect, params$label),
       subtitle = "TE LFC ~ CDS GC + log2 CDS length") +
  theme_classic(base_size = 12) + theme(plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 12),
                                        plot.subtitle = element_text(size = 13, face = "bold", hjust = 0.5))
p_len <- ggplot(d, aes(log2_cds_length, te_lfc)) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, colour = "grey50", linewidth = 0.3) +
  geom_point(colour = "grey70", size = 0.3, alpha = 0.4) +
  geom_line(data = line_len, aes(y = pred), colour = line_col, linewidth = 1) + fit_lab +
  coord_cartesian(ylim = ylim) +
  labs(x = "log2 CDS length (nt)", y = params$outcome_label,
       title = sprintf("%s vs CDS length\n%s", params$effect, params$label),
       subtitle = "TE LFC ~ CDS GC + log2 CDS length") +
  theme_classic(base_size = 12) + theme(plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 12),
                                        plot.subtitle = element_text(size = 13, face = "bold", hjust = 0.5))
p_gc
p_len
if (isTRUE(params$save_plots)) {
  ggsave(here("plots", paste0("13c_linear_model_cds_gc_", params$tag, ".pdf")), p_gc, width = 6.5, height = 5)
  ggsave(here("plots", paste0("13c_linear_model_cds_length_", params$tag, ".pdf")), p_len, width = 6.5, height = 5)
}
```

# 3b. Each variable on its own

The same plots with a one-term model each, `te_lfc ~ CDS GC` and `te_lfc ~ log2 CDS length`, so
each line and adjusted R² belong to that variable alone. GC and length are nearly independent
(Spearman rho -0.08), so each single-variable slope is close to its slope in the joint model,
only slightly shallower: GC-rich genes are a little shorter, which offsets a small part of each
effect when it is fit alone.

```{r figure_single, fig.width = 6, fig.height = 5}
fit_gc1 <- lm(te_lfc ~ cds_gc, data = d)
fit_len1 <- lm(te_lfc ~ log2_cds_length, data = d)
# Pearson r carries the sign R2 drops; with one predictor r^2 is the unadjusted R2.
single_lab <- function(m, x) annotate("text", x = Inf, y = Inf, hjust = 1.1, vjust = 1.4, size = 3.8,
  label = sprintf("Pearson r = %.3f\nadjusted R² = %.3f\nn = %s genes", cor(x, d$te_lfc),
                  summary(m)$adj.r.squared, scales::comma(nrow(d))))
stopifnot(abs(cor(d$cds_gc, d$te_lfc)^2 - summary(fit_gc1)$r.squared) < 1e-10,
          abs(cor(d$log2_cds_length, d$te_lfc)^2 - summary(fit_len1)$r.squared) < 1e-10)
cat(sprintf("adjusted R2: GC alone %.4f | length alone %.4f | both %.4f\n",
            summary(fit_gc1)$adj.r.squared, summary(fit_len1)$adj.r.squared, r2_adj))
p_gc1 <- ggplot(d, aes(cds_gc, te_lfc)) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, colour = "grey50", linewidth = 0.3) +
  geom_point(colour = "grey70", size = 0.3, alpha = 0.4) +
  geom_line(data = line_gc %>% mutate(pred = predict(fit_gc1, newdata = .)), aes(y = pred),
            colour = line_col, linewidth = 1) + single_lab(fit_gc1, d$cds_gc) +
  coord_cartesian(ylim = ylim) +
  labs(x = "CDS GC (%)", y = params$outcome_label,
       title = sprintf("%s vs CDS GC\n%s", params$effect, params$label),
       subtitle = "TE LFC ~ CDS GC") +
  theme_classic(base_size = 12) + theme(plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 12),
                                        plot.subtitle = element_text(size = 13, face = "bold", hjust = 0.5))
p_len1 <- ggplot(d, aes(log2_cds_length, te_lfc)) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, colour = "grey50", linewidth = 0.3) +
  geom_point(colour = "grey70", size = 0.3, alpha = 0.4) +
  geom_line(data = line_len %>% mutate(pred = predict(fit_len1, newdata = .)), aes(y = pred),
            colour = line_col, linewidth = 1) + single_lab(fit_len1, d$log2_cds_length) +
  coord_cartesian(ylim = ylim) +
  labs(x = "log2 CDS length (nt)", y = params$outcome_label,
       title = sprintf("%s vs CDS length\n%s", params$effect, params$label),
       subtitle = "TE LFC ~ log2 CDS length") +
  theme_classic(base_size = 12) + theme(plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 12),
                                        plot.subtitle = element_text(size = 13, face = "bold", hjust = 0.5))
p_gc1
p_len1
if (isTRUE(params$save_plots)) {
  ggsave(here("plots", paste0("13c_linear_model_cds_gc_only_", params$tag, ".pdf")), p_gc1, width = 6.5, height = 5)
  ggsave(here("plots", paste0("13c_linear_model_cds_length_only_", params$tag, ".pdf")), p_len1, width = 6.5, height = 5)
}
```

# 4. Does the GC effect depend on length? The interaction term

`te_lfc ~ cds_gc * log2_cds_length` adds one term, `cds_gc:log2_cds_length`, which lets the GC
slope change with CDS length. If it is zero, GC has the same effect on short and long mRNAs and
the additive model above is enough.

The figure splits genes into thirds by CDS length. Points are the **observed** mean TE change
in 5-point GC bins within each third (bins with fewer than 30 genes dropped); lines are the
interaction model's prediction at each third's median length. Parallel lines = no interaction.

```{r interaction}
fit_int <- lm(te_lfc ~ cds_gc * log2_cds_length, data = d)
int_row <- summary(fit_int)$coefficients["cds_gc:log2_cds_length", ]
int_test <- anova(fit, fit_int)
knitr::kable(summary(fit_int)$coefficients, digits = 6)
cat(sprintf("interaction: %.2e per GC point per doubling (SE %.2e), p = %.3f | F-test vs additive p = %.3f | adjusted R2 %.4f -> %.4f\n",
            int_row[["Estimate"]], int_row[["Std. Error"]], int_row[["Pr(>|t|)"]], int_test$`Pr(>F)`[2],
            r2_adj, summary(fit_int)$adj.r.squared))
# GC slope (per +10 points) implied at short / median / long CDS
len_q <- quantile(d$log2_cds_length, c(0.1, 0.5, 0.9))
tibble(cds_length_nt = round(2^len_q - 1),
       gc_slope_per_10pts = 10 * (coef(fit_int)[["cds_gc"]] + coef(fit_int)[["cds_gc:log2_cds_length"]] * len_q)) %>%
  knitr::kable(digits = 4)
```

```{r interaction_figure, fig.width = 7, fig.height = 5}
d <- d %>% mutate(len_third = ntile(log2_cds_length, 3))
thirds <- d %>% group_by(len_third) %>%
  summarise(n = n(), lo = min(log2_cds_length), hi = max(log2_cds_length), med_len = median(log2_cds_length), .groups = "drop") %>%
  mutate(label = sprintf("%.1f-%.1f (n = %s)", lo, hi,
                         scales::comma(n)))
len_cols <- setNames(c("#0072B2", "#CC79A7", "#009E73"), thirds$label)   # orange / sky blue are reserved for eIF3d / eIF3e
obs <- d %>% mutate(gc_bin = floor(cds_gc / 5) * 5 + 2.5) %>% group_by(len_third, gc_bin) %>%
  summarise(n = n(), mean_lfc = mean(te_lfc), se = sd(te_lfc) / sqrt(n), .groups = "drop") %>%
  filter(n >= 30) %>% left_join(thirds %>% dplyr::select(len_third, label), by = "len_third")
lines_int <- thirds %>% dplyr::select(len_third, label, med_len) %>%
  crossing(cds_gc = seq(min(obs$gc_bin) - 2.5, max(obs$gc_bin) + 2.5, length.out = 100)) %>%
  mutate(pred = predict(fit_int, newdata = tibble(cds_gc = cds_gc, log2_cds_length = med_len)))
p_int <- ggplot(obs, aes(gc_bin, mean_lfc, colour = label)) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, colour = "grey50", linewidth = 0.3) +
  geom_line(data = lines_int, aes(cds_gc, pred), linewidth = 0.8) +
  geom_pointrange(aes(ymin = mean_lfc - se, ymax = mean_lfc + se), size = 0.3) +
  scale_colour_manual(values = len_cols, breaks = thirds$label, name = "log2 CDS length third") +
  annotate("text", x = Inf, y = Inf, hjust = 1.1, vjust = 1.4, size = 3.8, colour = "black",
           label = sprintf("adjusted R² = %.3f\ninteraction p = %.2f\nn = %s genes", summary(fit_int)$adj.r.squared,
                           int_row[["Pr(>|t|)"]], scales::comma(nrow(d)))) +
  labs(x = "CDS GC (%)", y = params$outcome_label,
       title = sprintf("%s vs CDS GC\n%s, mean +/- SE per 5-point GC bin", params$effect, params$label),
       subtitle = "TE LFC ~ CDS GC * log2 CDS length") +
  theme_classic(base_size = 12) + theme(plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 12),
                                        plot.subtitle = element_text(size = 13, face = "bold", hjust = 0.5))
p_int
if (isTRUE(params$save_plots)) ggsave(here("plots", paste0("13c_linear_model_gc_length_interaction_", params$tag, ".pdf")), p_int, width = 7, height = 5)
```

# 4b. Seeing GC and length together

Three views of the two predictors at once:

- **Grid heatmap**: genes binned by CDS GC (5-point bins) and log2 CDS length (1-unit bins, one
  doubling), colored by the observed mean TE LFC per tile; tiles with fewer than 20 genes are
  blank. No model is involved. With no interaction, the color changes along both axes but
  the pattern is the same in every row and column.
- **Partial residual plots**: each gene's TE LFC with the *other* term's fitted effect removed
  (`te_lfc - b_other * (x_other - mean(x_other))`), plotted against this term, with the
  additive model's line. This is the data behind each unique effect. "Unique adjusted R²" is the
  combined model's adjusted R² minus that of the model without this term.
- **Predictor scatter**: CDS GC against log2 CDS length. They are nearly independent, which is
  why each term's slope barely changes when the other is added.

```{r together_grid, fig.width = 6.5, fig.height = 5}
grid <- d %>%
  mutate(gc_bin = floor(cds_gc / 5) * 5 + 2.5, len_bin = floor(log2_cds_length) + 0.5) %>%
  group_by(gc_bin, len_bin) %>%
  summarise(n = n(), mean_lfc = mean(te_lfc), .groups = "drop") %>%
  filter(n >= 20)
lim <- max(abs(grid$mean_lfc))
p_grid <- ggplot(grid, aes(gc_bin, len_bin, fill = mean_lfc)) +
  geom_tile(colour = "white", linewidth = 0.3) +
  scale_fill_gradientn(colours = c("#0072B2", "white", "#D55E00"), limits = c(-lim, lim),
                       name = "mean\nTE LFC") +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = seq(30, 80, 10)) + scale_y_continuous(breaks = 4:14) +
  labs(x = "CDS GC (%)", y = "log2 CDS length (nt)",
       title = sprintf("%s by CDS GC and length\n%s", params$effect, params$label),
       subtitle = "mean TE LFC per bin",
       caption = sprintf("%s genes in %d tiles with >= 20 genes", scales::comma(sum(grid$n)), nrow(grid))) +
  theme_classic(base_size = 12) + theme(plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 12),
                                        plot.subtitle = element_text(size = 13, face = "bold", hjust = 0.5))
p_grid
if (isTRUE(params$save_plots))
  ggsave(here("plots", paste0("13c_linear_model_gc_length_grid_", params$tag, ".pdf")), p_grid, width = 6.5, height = 5)
```

```{r together_partial, fig.width = 6, fig.height = 5}
b_gc <- coef(fit)[["cds_gc"]]; b_len <- coef(fit)[["log2_cds_length"]]
d <- d %>% mutate(pr_gc = te_lfc - b_len * (log2_cds_length - mean(log2_cds_length)),
                  pr_len = te_lfc - b_gc * (cds_gc - mean(cds_gc)))
# The additive model's line through the partial residuals has exactly that term's slope.
stopifnot(abs(coef(lm(pr_gc ~ cds_gc, d))[[2]] - b_gc) < 1e-10,
          abs(coef(lm(pr_len ~ log2_cds_length, d))[[2]] - b_len) < 1e-10)
uniq_gc <- r2_adj - summary(fit_len1)$adj.r.squared
uniq_len <- r2_adj - summary(fit_gc1)$adj.r.squared
beta_add <- coef(lm(scale(te_lfc) ~ scale(cds_gc) + scale(log2_cds_length), d))[-1]
pr_lab <- function(beta, uniq) annotate("text", x = Inf, y = Inf, hjust = 1.1, vjust = 1.4, size = 3.8,
  label = sprintf("standardized beta = %.3f\nunique adjusted R² = %.3f\nn = %s genes", beta, uniq, scales::comma(nrow(d))))
pr_line_gc <- tibble(cds_gc = range(d$cds_gc)) %>%
  mutate(pred = coef(fit)[[1]] + b_gc * cds_gc + b_len * mean(d$log2_cds_length))
pr_line_len <- tibble(log2_cds_length = range(d$log2_cds_length)) %>%
  mutate(pred = coef(fit)[[1]] + b_len * log2_cds_length + b_gc * mean(d$cds_gc))
p_pr_gc <- ggplot(d, aes(cds_gc, pr_gc)) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, colour = "grey50", linewidth = 0.3) +
  geom_point(colour = "grey70", size = 0.3, alpha = 0.4) +
  geom_line(data = pr_line_gc, aes(y = pred), colour = line_col, linewidth = 1) +
  pr_lab(beta_add[[1]], uniq_gc) + coord_cartesian(ylim = ylim) +
  labs(x = "CDS GC (%)", y = "TE LFC, adjusted for CDS length",
       title = sprintf("%s vs CDS GC, length removed\n%s", params$effect, params$label),
       subtitle = "TE LFC ~ CDS GC + log2 CDS length") +
  theme_classic(base_size = 12) + theme(plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 12),
                                        plot.subtitle = element_text(size = 13, face = "bold", hjust = 0.5))
p_pr_len <- ggplot(d, aes(log2_cds_length, pr_len)) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, colour = "grey50", linewidth = 0.3) +
  geom_point(colour = "grey70", size = 0.3, alpha = 0.4) +
  geom_line(data = pr_line_len, aes(y = pred), colour = line_col, linewidth = 1) +
  pr_lab(beta_add[[2]], uniq_len) + coord_cartesian(ylim = ylim) +
  labs(x = "log2 CDS length (nt)", y = "TE LFC, adjusted for CDS GC",
       title = sprintf("%s vs CDS length, GC removed\n%s", params$effect, params$label),
       subtitle = "TE LFC ~ CDS GC + log2 CDS length") +
  theme_classic(base_size = 12) + theme(plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 12),
                                        plot.subtitle = element_text(size = 13, face = "bold", hjust = 0.5))
p_pr_gc
p_pr_len
if (isTRUE(params$save_plots)) {
  ggsave(here("plots", paste0("13c_linear_model_partial_cds_gc_", params$tag, ".pdf")), p_pr_gc, width = 6.5, height = 5)
  ggsave(here("plots", paste0("13c_linear_model_partial_cds_length_", params$tag, ".pdf")), p_pr_len, width = 6.5, height = 5)
```

# 5. Beta coefficients for every model

One row per term per model, with two kinds of coefficient:

- **b** (unstandardized): the slope in the model's own units, LFC per GC percentage point or per
  log2 unit (one doubling) of CDS length.
- **beta** (standardized): the same model refit with the outcome and both predictors z-scored,
  so it is the change in TE change, in SDs, per SD of the predictor, comparable across terms.
  With one predictor, beta equals Pearson r. For the interaction model the predictors are
  z-scored *before* forming the product, so the main-effect betas are the slopes at the mean of
  the other term rather than at zero.

```{r betas}
zd <- d %>% mutate(z_te = as.numeric(scale(te_lfc)), z_gc = as.numeric(scale(cds_gc)),
                   z_len = as.numeric(scale(log2_cds_length)))
models <- list(
  "CDS GC only"          = list(raw = te_lfc ~ cds_gc,                     z = z_te ~ z_gc),
  "CDS length only"      = list(raw = te_lfc ~ log2_cds_length,            z = z_te ~ z_len),
  "CDS GC + CDS length"  = list(raw = te_lfc ~ cds_gc + log2_cds_length,   z = z_te ~ z_gc + z_len),
  "CDS GC * CDS length"  = list(raw = te_lfc ~ cds_gc * log2_cds_length,   z = z_te ~ z_gc * z_len))
term_names <- c(cds_gc = "CDS GC", log2_cds_length = "log2 CDS length",
                "cds_gc:log2_cds_length" = "CDS GC x log2 CDS length")
betas <- imap_dfr(models, function(m, nm) {
  fr <- lm(m$raw, data = d); fz <- lm(m$z, data = zd)
  sr <- summary(fr)$coefficients[-1, , drop = FALSE]; ci <- confint(fr)[-1, , drop = FALSE]
  ciz <- confint(fz)[-1, , drop = FALSE]
  stopifnot(length(coef(fz)) == length(coef(fr)))   # same terms in the same order
  tibble(model = nm, term = unname(term_names[rownames(sr)]),
         b = sr[, "Estimate"], b_se = sr[, "Std. Error"], b_lo = ci[, 1], b_hi = ci[, 2],
         beta = unname(coef(fz)[-1]), beta_lo = ciz[, 1], beta_hi = ciz[, 2], p = sr[, "Pr(>|t|)"],
         adj_r2 = summary(fr)$adj.r.squared, n = nobs(fr))
})
# beta of a one-predictor model is Pearson r
stopifnot(abs(betas$beta[betas$model == "CDS GC only"] - cor(d$cds_gc, d$te_lfc)) < 1e-10,
          abs(betas$beta[betas$model == "CDS length only"] - cor(d$log2_cds_length, d$te_lfc)) < 1e-10)
knitr::kable(betas, digits = c(0, 0, 5, 5, 5, 5, 3, 3, 3, 300, 4, 0))
```

```{r beta_bar, fig.width = 7, fig.height = 4.5}
term_cols <- c("CDS GC" = "#0072B2", "log2 CDS length" = "#CC79A7", "CDS GC x log2 CDS length" = "#009E73")
model_labs <- betas %>% distinct(model, adj_r2) %>%
  mutate(lab = sprintf("%s\nadj. R² = %.3f", model, adj_r2))
bd <- betas %>% left_join(model_labs %>% dplyr::select(model, lab), by = "model") %>%
  mutate(lab = factor(lab, levels = model_labs$lab), term = factor(term, levels = names(term_cols)))
p_beta <- ggplot(bd, aes(lab, beta, fill = term)) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, colour = "grey50", linewidth = 0.3) +
  geom_col(position = position_dodge(width = 0.8, preserve = "single"), width = 0.75) +
  geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = beta_lo, ymax = beta_hi),
                position = position_dodge(width = 0.8, preserve = "single"), width = 0.2, linewidth = 0.4) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = term_cols, name = NULL) +
  labs(x = NULL, y = "standardized beta (SD per SD)",
       title = sprintf("%s, standardized betas\n%s", params$effect, params$label),
       subtitle = sprintf("error bars = 95%% CI; n = %s genes", scales::comma(nrow(d)))) +
  theme_classic(base_size = 12) + theme(plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 12),
                                        plot.subtitle = element_text(size = 9),
                                        axis.text.x = element_text(size = 9), legend.position = "bottom")
p_beta
if (isTRUE(params$save_plots))
  ggsave(here("plots", paste0("13c_linear_model_betas_", params$tag, ".pdf")), p_beta, width = 7, height = 4.5)
```

The same betas as magnitudes, |beta|, so bar height reads directly as effect size. The sign is
stated in the subtitle, computed from the data (and each term is asserted to keep one sign across
models, so the subtitle cannot misdescribe a bar). The 95% CI of |beta| is the absolute CI when it excludes zero; when it
spans zero (the interaction term) the interval runs from 0 to the larger absolute end.

```{r beta_bar_abs, fig.width = 7, fig.height = 4.5}
bd_abs <- bd %>% mutate(
  abs_beta = abs(beta),
  crosses = beta_lo < 0 & beta_hi > 0,
  abs_lo = ifelse(crosses, 0, pmin(abs(beta_lo), abs(beta_hi))),
  abs_hi = pmax(abs(beta_lo), abs(beta_hi)),
  sign_lab = ifelse(crosses, "n.s.", ""))
# The bars drop the sign, so the subtitle states it from the data. Each term must keep one sign
# across the models it appears in (ignoring CIs that span 0), or one subtitle cannot describe it.
sign_of <- bd_abs %>% filter(!crosses) %>% group_by(term) %>% summarise(sg = unique(sign(beta)), .groups = "drop")
stopifnot("a term changes sign between models - the absolute plot would hide it" = !anyDuplicated(sign_of$term))
sign_txt <- paste(sprintf("%s %s", sign_of$term, ifelse(sign_of$sg < 0, "negative", "positive")), collapse = ", ")
ns_txt <- unique(as.character(bd_abs$term[bd_abs$crosses]))
ns_txt <- if (length(ns_txt)) paste0("; 95% CI spans 0: ", paste(ns_txt, collapse = ", ")) else ""
stopifnot("|beta| outside its own CI" = all(bd_abs$abs_beta >= bd_abs$abs_lo - 1e-12 & bd_abs$abs_beta <= bd_abs$abs_hi + 1e-12))
p_beta_abs <- ggplot(bd_abs, aes(lab, abs_beta, fill = term)) +
  geom_col(position = position_dodge(width = 0.8, preserve = "single"), width = 0.75) +
  geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = abs_lo, ymax = abs_hi),
                position = position_dodge(width = 0.8, preserve = "single"), width = 0.2, linewidth = 0.4) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = term_cols, name = NULL) +
  scale_y_continuous(expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.1))) +
  labs(x = NULL, y = "absolute standardized beta (SD per SD)",
       title = sprintf("%s, size of each effect\n%s", params$effect, params$label),
       subtitle = sprintf("signs: %s\n(negative = higher value, lower TE LFC); error bars = 95%% CI%s; n = %s genes", sign_txt, ns_txt, scales::comma(nrow(d)))) +
  theme_classic(base_size = 12) + theme(plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 12),
                                        plot.subtitle = element_text(size = 9),
                                        axis.text.x = element_text(size = 9), legend.position = "bottom")
p_beta_abs
if (isTRUE(params$save_plots))
  ggsave(here("plots", paste0("13c_linear_model_betas_abs_", params$tag, ".pdf")), p_beta_abs, width = 7, height = 4.5)
```

```{r save}
            file.path(O, paste0("linear_model_gc_length_", params$tag, "_coefficients.csv")))
```
